annotations.title: Every branch in me.
annotations.text: By this it appeareth that Christ hath some branches in his body mystical that be fruitless: therefore ill livers also may be members of Christ and the Church, though none can be saved but fruitful branches.

annotations.title: More fruit.
annotations.text: This proveth that a just man may continually increase in justice & sanctification so long as he liveth.

annotations.title: Vnles it abide.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Whosoeuer by Heresie or Schisme or for any other cause is cut of or separated from the Church, he can do no meritorious worke to Saluation.

notes.text: No salvation out of the Church.

annotations.title: Vnles you abide.
annotations.text: ◦ These conditional speaches, If you remaine in the vine, If you keepe my commaundements, and such like, giue vs to wit that we be not sure to persist or perseuêre, nor to be saued, but vnder conditions to be fulfilled by vs. Aug. de corrept. & gra. c. 13.

annotations.title: Keepe my praecepts.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This careful and often admonition of keeping his commaundements, proueth that a Christian mans life is not onely or principally in faith, but in good workes.

notes.text: Only faith sufficeth not to salvation.

annotations.title: If I had.
annotations.text: If the Iewes had not sinned by refusing Christ, in case he had not done greater miracles then any other: then were it a great folly of Catholikes to beleeue Luthers or Caluins new opinions without any miracles at all.

annotations.title: Whom I wil send.
annotations.text: The Holy Ghost is sent by the Sonne, therfore he procedeth from him also, as from the Father: though the late Schismatical Greekes thinke otherwise.

annotations.title: You shal giue.
annotations.text: He vouchsafeth to ioyne together the testimonie of the Holy Ghost, and of the Apostles: that we may see the testimonie of truth ioyntly to consist in the Holy Ghost and in the Prelats of the Church.
